## Design note

The parcel van that stops wherever it likes. Tall, slab-sided and gutless next to the V8 vans, it catches every crosswind and leans hard in a turn, but it is lighter than it looks and the diesel pulls well in the gears. Every street in the city has one with its hazards on.

## How this car breaks

Unibody van: a car-like crumple zone under a short nose, so a hard frontal folds the front end and the cab footwell. The cargo box behind the bulkhead is thin sheet on light hoops — side and rear hits dent it deeply without touching the cab. The tall flat side is an easy target and the high CG tips it in hard swerves.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s European high-roof RWD vans
- manufacturer spec-class data for 2.1 L common-rail van diesels
- engineering tables (light-truck tire radius, ride frequency, caliper hydraulics)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| Axis | Box (kg·m²) | k | `inertia_kgm2` |
|---|---|---|---|
| roll | 2166 | 0.85 | 1840 |
| pitch | 8106 | 0.95 | 7700 |
| yaw | 7464 | 0.97 | 7240 |

## Aerodynamics

Frontal area A = 0.86·W·H = 4.62 m²; Cd = 0.37 → **CdA = 1.710 m²**. Lift Cl·A front/rear = +0.15 / +0.12 m² (class-typical; positive = lift). No add-on aero (`aero_downforce_coeffs` = 0, mods add it).

## Engine

2.1 L DOHC 16-valve turbo-diesel I4, common-rail, variable-geometry turbo. Class-typical 2010s 2.1 L van diesel (~54 kW/L, ~113 kW at 3600 rpm, ~360 N·m at 1600-2400) per manufacturer spec-class data.

Peak **113 kW @ 3600 rpm**, **360 N·m @ 1600 rpm**. Idle 750 / redline 4000 / limiter 4200 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.20 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 43 N·m. Power-to-weight 49 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed manual, open rear differential. Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 500 N·m. Shift time 0.35 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |

| 2 | 2.60 | 10.19 | 51 |
| 3 | 1.52 | 5.96 | 86 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 3.92 | 131 |
| 5 | 0.79 | 3.10 | 166 |
| 6 | 0.64 | 2.51 | 205 |

Final drive 3.92, reverse 4.50. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.342 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.27 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 597 kg | 1.35 Hz | 43000 N/m | 2740 N·s/m | 4110 N·s/m | 0.18 m |
| Rear | 470 kg | 1.65 Hz | 50500 N/m | 2630 N·s/m | 3940 N·s/m | 0.20 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 5.5°/g with 68% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.752 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 177552 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 63574 F / 73830 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **19300 F / 0 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 5.0°/g, front share 62%. Bump stops 300000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 300 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm + 54 mm → A = 45.8 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 125 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·45.8 cm²·0.125 m = **4580 N·m**
- Rear: 298 mm disc, pistons per side 44 mm → A = 15.2 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 124 mm, pad μ = 0.4: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.4·100 bar·15.2 cm²·0.124 m = **1508 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 3028 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.51×), rear needs 844 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.79×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 1277 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.542** → delivered 4580 N·m front / 1276 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 1060 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 18.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 13.6 m → outer-front path radius 6.68 m, rear-axle-centre radius 4.73 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.659 rad (37.8°)** (outer 33.3°, inner 43.5° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.1 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/parcel_hi.json`)

325 nodes, 2125 beams, 8 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id parcel_hi --profile suv --width 1.99 --length 5.9 --height 2.7 --wheelbase 3.665 --mass 508.3 --car-mass 2310.4 --clearance 0.18 --front-overhang 0.95 --strength 1.15` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 4).
- Era `2010s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Steel hood: 159 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Cargo box: 50 Cabin nodes behind the seat partition (y < 0.03 m, just behind the front doors) relabelled FrameRear — the passenger cell is the cab only, so cargo-box hits are body damage, not cabin intrusion.
